claims.detail: Committed exemplar: HTTPS web tier, application tier, and data tier separated with managed identity database access.

findings.description: Three-tier layout keeps HTTPS ingress at the edge with App Service handling session state separately from the OLTP database tier.
findings.recommendation: Validate TLS chains and slot swap behavior before widening autoscale maximum instances.

findings.description: Managed identities reach Azure SQL and Key Vault without embedding passwords in application configuration files.
findings.recommendation: Rotate client secrets for any remaining legacy service principals quarterly.
